answer: Agents register via SGX/TPM enclave attestation binding each hardware-rooted key to measured code and a nonce. The hollow state tree commits identities under the ivory hash anchor; the nadir consensus contract rejects duplicate measurements and stale proofs. Forging an identity requires compromising a physical enclave or reproducing its secret. N identities require distinct silicon and quadratic bonding collateral, O(N^2); failed proofs are irreversibly slashed.
